description: This file defines the internal class HistogramAggregator, which is responsible for aggregating histogram data, including recording values, collecting bucket measurements, count, and sum, within the Orleans runtime metrics system.

classes.name: HistogramAggregator
classes.description: An internal class used for aggregating histogram metrics, managing buckets, counts, and sums, and providing methods to record data and collect measurements.

methods.name: HistogramAggregator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the histogram buckets, tags, and label generator.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Records a new data point into the appropriate histogram bucket, updating count and sum atomically.

methods.name: CollectBuckets
methods.description: Collects and returns measurements for all histogram buckets.

methods.name: CollectCount
methods.description: Returns a measurement of the total count of recorded data points.

methods.name: CollectSum
methods.description: Returns a measurement of the total sum of recorded data points.
